name: BOSU Ball Squat
steps: Place a BOSU ball platform-side down on the floor and step carefully onto the center of the dome with feet shoulder-width apart.
Find your balance with knees softly unlocked, chest lifted, and core braced.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees smoothly into a controlled squat while keeping weight centered over both feet.
Drive steadily through both feet to stand tall again without tipping the dome.
tips: Squat only as deep as you can while keeping your knees tracking steadily over your toes.
Fix your gaze on a stationary spot ahead to help steady your ankles.
